nepali_explanation: केही शब्दहरूको अनौपचारिक/plain समानार्थी शब्द हुन्छन्, जुन प्रायः पुरुषले वा बराबर/तल्लो स्तरका व्यक्तिहरूले प्रयोग गर्छन्। ぼक (म, पुरुषहरूद्वारा प्रयोग गरिने わたし को अनौपचारिक शब्द), きみ (तिमी, बराबर वा तल्लो स्तरका मानिसहरूलाई सम्बोधन गर्न प्रयोग गरिने あなた को अनौपचारिक शब्द), ～くん (～जी, बराबर वा तल्लो स्तरका पुरुषहरूलाई सम्बोधन गर्न साथै केटा मान्छेको नामपछाडि जोडिने ～さん को अनौपचारिक शब्द)।

examples.japanese: ぼくは がくせいだ。
examples.romaji: Boku wa gakusei da.
examples.english: I am a student. (informal, male speaker)

grammar_point: こっち／そっち／あっち／どっち (Informal direction words)
form: こっち/そっち/あっち/どっち
english_explanation: These are the informal, casual equivalents of こちら/そちら/あちら/どちら.
nepali_explanation: यी こちら/そちら/あちら/どちら का अनौपचारिक (casual) रूप हुन्।

examples.japanese: どっちが いい？
examples.romaji: Docchi ga ii?
examples.english: Which one is better?

grammar_point: Plain Form と おもいます。 (I think that ~)
form: Plain Form と おもいます。
english_explanation: Used to express one's own thought, opinion, or guess about something. To ask someone's opinion about a topic, use ～に ついて どう おもいますか — note that in this question pattern, と is not needed after どう.
nepali_explanation: कुनै कुरा, वस्तु वा घटनाको बारेमा यस्तो जस्तो लाग्छ, उस्तो जस्तो लाग्छ भनेर आफ्नो विचार वा अनुमान व्यक्त गर्नुपर्दा यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ। ～に ついて どう おもいますか को प्रयोग गरी अरुलाई कुनै कुराको बारेमा राय वा विचार सोध्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ। यहाँ どう को पछाडि と को आवश्यकता पर्दैन।

examples.japanese: あした あめが ふる と おもいます。
examples.romaji: Ashita ame ga furu to omoimasu.
examples.english: I think it will rain tomorrow.

examples.japanese: にほんに ついて どう おもいますか。 ちょっと ぶっかが たかいと おもいます。
examples.romaji: Nihon ni tsuite dō omoimasu ka. Chotto bukka ga takai to omoimasu.
examples.english: What do you think about Japan? I think prices are a bit high.

grammar_point: Sentence Plain Form と いいました。 (Said that ~)
form: Plain Form と いいました。
english_explanation: Used to report exactly what someone else said — 'so-and-so said such-and-such'.
nepali_explanation: अर्कोकसैले भनेको कुरालाई जस्ताको त्यस्तै त्यसो भन्यो, उसो भन्यो भनेर बताउनुपर्दा यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: おとうとは あした がっこうへ いかない と いいました。
examples.romaji: Otōto wa ashita gakkō e ikanai to iimashita.
examples.english: My younger brother said he won't go to school tomorrow.

examples.japanese: せんせいは わたしの こたえが ただしい と いいました。
examples.romaji: Sensei wa watashi no kotae ga tadashii to iimashita.
examples.english: The teacher said my answer was correct.

grammar_point: Plain Form → でしょう？ (Isn't it? / Right?)
english_explanation: Used when speaking, hoping the listener already knows or is aware of something, to confirm 'isn't that so?' about something that already happened or is about to happen.
nepali_explanation: श्रोता (listener) लाई केही ज्ञानभएको अपेक्षा गरी पहिले भैसकेको कुरालाई वा अब यसपछि हुन लागेको कुरालाई 'यसो हैन त?' भनेर निश्चय गर्ने आशयमा बोलिँदा यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: きのう マヤさんに あった でしょう？
examples.romaji: Kinō Maya-san ni atta deshō?
examples.english: You met Maya yesterday, right?

examples.japanese: あしたは やすみ でしょう？
examples.romaji: Ashita wa yasumi deshō?
examples.english: Tomorrow is a holiday, right?

grammar_point: N₁(place)で N₂が あります。 (An event is being held)
form: N₁(place)で N₂が あります।
english_explanation: When N2 refers to an event such as a game, party, concert, or festival, あります takes on the meaning 'is being held/is taking place' rather than just 'exists'.
nepali_explanation: यहाँ ha N2 ले कुनै event जस्तै खेल, पार्टी, कन्सर्ट, चाडपर्व इत्यादि व्यक्त गर्दा ta あります को अर्थ '...हुन गइरहेको छ' भन्ने हुन्छ।

examples.japanese: とうきょうで サッカーの しあいが あります。
examples.romaji: Tōkyō de sakkā no shiai ga arimasu.
examples.english: There is a soccer match happening in Tokyo.

grammar_point: N(occasion)で
english_explanation: When a certain action happens on a specific occasion, で marks that occasion.
nepali_explanation: जब निश्चित अवसरमा कुनै कार्य हुन्छ भने त्यसलाई P-で ले संकेत गर्दछ।

examples.japanese: コンサートで この しゃしんを とりました。
examples.romaji: Konsāto de kono shashin o torimashita.
examples.english: I took this photo at the concert.

grammar_point: N でも Verb (~ or something)
english_explanation: でも is used to give one example among similar things as a suggestion — offering, encouraging, or advising someone.
nepali_explanation: यहाँ でも को प्रयोग गरी एकैप्रकारका चिजबाट कुनैएक उदाहरणको रुपमा प्रयोग गरी कसैलाई सुझाव, प्रोत्साहन वा सल्लाह दिन प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: おちゃでも のみませんか。
examples.romaji: Ocha demo nomimasen ka.
examples.english: Won't you have tea or something?

grammar_point: V ないと………… (Have to ~ / must)
english_explanation: This is the shortened form of V ないと いけません, formed by dropping いけません. Both forms are still considered to carry the same meaning.
nepali_explanation: यो स्वरूप V ないと いけません को いけません लाई हटाई बनाइएको हो। त्यसैले यी दुबै स्वरूप उस्तै मानिन्छन्।

examples.japanese: もう かえらないと……。
examples.romaji: Mō kaeranai to...
examples.english: I have to go home now.

grammar_point: Noun Modification
english_explanation: We already learned in Lessons 2 and 8 how to modify a Noun using another adjective or noun before it.
nepali_explanation: हामीले पाठ २ र पाठ ८ मा Noun लाई परिमार्जन गर्न सिकेका थियौं।

examples.japanese: きむらさんの うち。
examples.romaji: Kimura-san no uchi.
examples.english: Mr. Kimura's house.

examples.japanese: きれいな うち。
examples.romaji: Kirei na uchi.
examples.english: A beautiful house.

grammar_point: Noun Modification by Sentences
english_explanation: A whole sentence can also be turned into a noun modifier. To do this, the noun being modified is placed right after the sentence in plain form. However, for な-adjective sentences, ～な is used instead of ～だ; and for Noun sentences, ～の is used instead of ～だ. This lets you turn an entire clause into a descriptor like 'the person who eats meat' or 'the house I bought yesterday' — and the whole modified phrase can then be used as a single noun (even changing Topic to Subject if needed).
nepali_explanation: वाक्यलाई पनि Noun को रुपमा परिमार्जन गर्न सकिन्छ। यसो गर्दा plain form को पछि परिमार्जन गर्नुपर्ने Noun लाई राखिन्छ। तथापि な-adjective sentences को मामला (case) मा भने ～だ को ठाउँमा ～な को प्रयोग हुन्छ र Noun sentences को मामला (case) मा भने ～だ को ठाउँमा ～の को प्रयोग हुन्छ। यसरी Modified गरिएको Noun लाई Sentence बाट Single Noun को रुपमा हेरिने भएकोले आवश्यकता अनुसार प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ।

examples.japanese: にくを たべる ひと (a person who eats meat)
examples.romaji: niku o taberu hito
examples.english: a person who eats meat

examples.japanese: マヤさんが すんで いた うち。 (the house where Maya used to live)
examples.romaji: Maya-san ga sunde ita uchi.
examples.english: the house where Maya used to live

grammar_point: Verb Root Form + じかん／やくそく／ようじ
form: V root + じかん/やくそく/ようじ
english_explanation: Before words like じかん (time), やくそく (promise/appointment), and ようじ (business/errand), the verb must be in the Root form.
nepali_explanation: じかん、やくそく र ようじ को अघि को Verb चाँही Root form मा प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: あさごはんを たべる じかんが ありません。
examples.romaji: Asagohan o taberu jikan ga arimasen.
examples.english: I don't have time to eat breakfast.

examples.japanese: ともだちと えいがを みる やくそくが あります。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi to eiga o miru yakusoku ga arimasu.
examples.english: I have a promise to watch a movie with a friend.

grammar_point: V root/ V ない/ い-adj/ な-adj な/ Noun の + とき、～ (When ~)
english_explanation: とき means 'time/moment'. とき connects two clauses and expresses the timing of the action/state in the main clause. Note: if the Noun before とき is related to a time word (like あさ, ひる, よる), の is not used before とき.
nepali_explanation: とき को अर्थ बेला वा समय हुन्छ। とき ले दुई वाक्यलाई जोड्छ र मुख्य खण्डमा हुने वा गरिने कार्य वा अवस्थाको समयलाई व्यक्त गर्दछ।

examples.japanese: としょかんで ほんを かりる とき、カードが いります。
examples.romaji: Toshokan de hon o kariru toki, kādo ga irimasu.
examples.english: When borrowing a book from the library, you need a card.

examples.japanese: ひまな とき、えいがを みに いきませんか。
examples.romaji: Hima na toki, eiga o mi ni ikimasen ka.
examples.english: When you're free, won't you go watch a movie?

grammar_point: Verb Root/V た-form + とき、～ (Before/After nuance)
english_explanation: When Verb Root form comes before とき, it indicates the action hasn't been completed yet at that moment. When V た-form comes before とき, it indicates the action was already completed at that moment.
nepali_explanation: जब とき को अघि Verb Root form राखिन्छ भने यसले कार्य पुरा नभएको संकेत गर्दछ, र とき को अघि V た-form राखिन्छ भने यसले कार्य समाप्त भएको संकेत गर्दछ।

examples.japanese: くにへ かえる とき、めがねを かいました。
examples.romaji: Kuni e kaeru toki, megane o kaimashita.
examples.english: When (about to) return to my country, I bought glasses.

examples.japanese: くにへ かえった とき、めがねを かいました。
examples.romaji: Kuni e kaetta toki, megane o kaimashita.
examples.english: When I had (already) returned to my country, I bought glasses.

grammar_point: Verb Root Form と、～ (main clause)
english_explanation: と connects two clauses when a certain result inevitably or naturally follows a certain action or condition — like a rule or mechanism. Note: と cannot be used to express one's own wish, hope, invitation, or request; たら (Lesson 25) is used instead for those cases.
nepali_explanation: जब कुनै परिस्थिति व्यक्तगर्दा, कुनै निश्चित कार्यको परिणाम स्वरुप अर्को कार्य वा कुरा अनिवार्य रुपमा घटित हुन्छ भने, と को प्रयोग गरी वाक्यहरूलाई जोडिन्छ। ध्यान दिनुहोस्: एक व्यक्तीको इच्छा, आशा, निमन्त्रणा वा अनुरोधको अभिव्यक्तिहरू यस स्वरूपमा प्रयोग गर्न सकिँदैन — त्यसको लागि たら (पाठ २५) प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: この ボタンを おすと、おつりが でます。
examples.romaji: Kono botan o osu to, otsuri ga demasu.
examples.english: If you press this button, change comes out.

examples.japanese: みぎへ まがると、びょういんが あります。
examples.romaji: Migi e magaru to, byōin ga arimasu.
examples.english: If you turn right, there is a hospital.

grammar_point: Noun が adjective (Ongoing state)
english_explanation: Used to give information about a state or condition that continues to exist as it is right now.
nepali_explanation: यथावत रहिरहेका कुराको जानकारी गराउन यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ। यथावत रहिरहेको विषय (subject) लाई P-が ले संकेत गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: ラジオの おとが ちいさいです。
examples.romaji: Rajio no oto ga chiisai desu.
examples.english: The radio's sound is small.

examples.japanese: からだの ちょうしが わるいです。
examples.romaji: Karada no chōshi ga warui desu.
examples.english: My physical condition is bad.

grammar_point: N(place)を V(verb of movement)
english_explanation: を marks the place/route through which a movement action passes. This applies to movement verbs like さんぽします (take a walk), わたります (cross), あるきます (walk), etc.
nepali_explanation: कुनै ठाउँबाट गुज्रने कार्य हुँदा त्यसलाई P-を ले संकेत गर्दछ। यो नियम さんぽします、わたります、あるきます जस्ता Movement verb हरूमा लागू हुन्छ।

examples.japanese: こうえんを さんぽします。
examples.romaji: Kōen o sanpo shimasu.
examples.english: I take a walk through the park.

examples.japanese: はしを わたります。
examples.romaji: Hashi o watarimasu.
examples.english: I cross the bridge.

grammar_point: くれます (Someone gives me ~)
form: N は わたしに N₂を くれます。
english_explanation: We learned that あげます means 'give' in Lesson 7. However, when the speaker (or the speaker's family) is the one receiving something from someone else, あげます cannot be used — instead, くれます must be used.
nepali_explanation: हामीले あげます को अर्थ दिन्छु/दिनुहुन्छ भनेर पाठ ७ मा अध्ययन गरेका थियौं। यदि वक्ता (speaker) वा वक्ताको परिवार (speaker's family) लाई कसैले केही दिएको खण्डमा यस क्रियापदको प्रयोग गर्न मिल्दैन। यस अवस्थामा くれます क्रियापदको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: わたしは マヤさんに はなを あげました。
examples.romaji: Watashi wa Maya-san ni hana o agemashita.
examples.english: I gave flowers to Maya.

examples.japanese: マヤさんは わたしに はなを くれました。
examples.romaji: Maya-san wa watashi ni hana o kuremashita.
examples.english: Maya gave me flowers.

grammar_point: V て-form あげます／もらいます／くれます
form: V て-form あげます/もらいます/くれます
english_explanation: These forms are also very commonly used. あげます (て-form): expresses doing a favor for someone, giving/doing something for them out of goodwill. もらいます (て-form): expresses gratitude on the receiving end — receiving a favor from someone. くれます (て-form): expresses that someone does a favor for the speaker or the speaker's family member, out of goodwill.
nepali_explanation: यी स्वरूप पनि धेरै चल्तीमा आउने स्वरूप हो। V て-form あげます: सद्भावना वा कृतज्ञताको भाव व्यक्त गर्दै आफुले कसैलाई केही गरिदिन्छु वा दिनुहुन्छ भन्ने कुरा व्यक्त गर्दछ। V て-form もらいます: प्राप्तकर्ताको पक्षमा कृतज्ञताको भावना व्यक्त गर्नुपर्दा प्रयोग गरिन्छ। V て-form くれます: सद्भावनाको भावका साथ कसैले आफ्नो वा आफ्नो परिवारको सदस्यको लागि केही गरि दिनुहुन्छ भन्ने कुरा व्यक्त गर्दछ।

examples.japanese: わたしは マヤさんに かんじを おしえて あげました。
examples.romaji: Watashi wa Maya-san ni kanji o oshiete agemashita.
examples.english: I taught Maya kanji (as a favor).

examples.japanese: わたしは スレスさんに ギターを おしえて もらいました。
examples.romaji: Watashi wa Suresu-san ni gitā o oshiete moraimashita.
examples.english: I had Suresh teach me guitar (gratefully).

examples.japanese: マヤさんは わたしに かんじを おしえて くれました。
examples.romaji: Maya-san wa watashi ni kanji o oshiete kuremashita.
examples.english: Maya (kindly) taught me kanji.

grammar_point: N₁ は N₂が Verb (New information marker)
english_explanation: が marks the part of the sentence that gives new information to the listener.
nepali_explanation: वाक्यमा नयाँ जानकारी दिने विषयलाई P-が ले संकेत गर्दछ।

examples.japanese: すてきな ネクタイですね。 ええ、ちちが くれました。
examples.romaji: Suteki na nekutai desu ne. Ee, chichi ga kuremashita.
examples.english: What a nice tie! Yes, my father gave it to me.

grammar_point: だれが Verb か (Who did it?)
english_explanation: だれが means 'who' as the doer of an action. It is used to ask who performs or performed a certain action.
nepali_explanation: यहाँ だれが को अर्थ 'कस्ले' हुन्छ। कुनै कार्य कस्ले गर्नुहुन्छ वा गर्नुभयो भनेर प्रश्न गर्नुपर्दा यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: だれが この レポートを かきましたか。 スレスさんが かきました。
examples.romaji: Dare ga kono repōto o kakimashita ka. Suresu-san ga kakimashita.
examples.english: Who wrote this report? Suresh wrote it.

grammar_point: Plain Past Form ら、～ (If ~, then ~)
english_explanation: Used to express a conditional/hypothetical situation — 'if this happens/is the case, then...'. It's used when the speaker wants to express an opinion, condition, request, etc. in a conditional way.
nepali_explanation: यदि यसो भयो भने वा यस्तो भएको खण्डमा भनेर परिस्थितिजन्य शर्तलाई प्रकाशमा ल्याउन यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ। वक्ताले सशर्त (conditional) मा आफ्नो राय, स्थिति, अनुरोध आदि व्यक्त गर्न चाहेमा यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: おかねが あったら、りょこうします。
examples.romaji: Okane ga attara, ryokō shimasu.
examples.english: If I have money, I will travel.

examples.japanese: あめが ふったら、がっこうを やすみます。
examples.romaji: Ame ga futtara, gakkō o yasumimasu.
examples.english: If it rains, I will take a day off school.

grammar_point: V た-form ら、～ (After doing V1, then V2)
english_explanation: Used to express doing V2 after a definite future action (V1) is completed or has happened. The main clause (V2) after V た-form ら is always in present tense (non-past).
nepali_explanation: भविष्यमा हुने निश्चित कुनैयौटा कार्य पुरा भइसकेपछि वा गरिसकेपछि अर्को कुनै कार्य हुन्छ वा गरिन्छ भनेर व्यक्त गर्नुपर्दा यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ। V た-form ら पछि प्रयोग हुने मुख्य वाक्य सधैं वर्तमानकाल (present tense) मा हुन्छ।

examples.japanese: １０じに なったら、でかけましょう。
examples.romaji: Jūji ni nattara, dekakemashō.
examples.english: Once it becomes 10 o'clock, let's go out.

examples.japanese: うちへ かえったら、すぐ シャワーを あびます。
examples.romaji: Uchi e kaettara, sugu shawā o abimasu.
examples.english: After I get home, I will take a shower right away.

grammar_point: V て-form／V ない(なくて)／い-adj(くて)／な-adj(で)／Noun で も、～ (Even if ~)
english_explanation: Used to express that regardless of a certain condition, or even after doing a certain action, the opposite/contrary result still happens or is done.
nepali_explanation: कुनै अवस्था भएपनि वा कुनै कार्य गरेपनि त्यस विपरित कुनै कार्य हुन्छ वा गरिन्छ भन्ने कुरालाई व्यक्त गर्नुपर्दा यो स्वरूपको प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: あめが ふっても、せんたくします。
examples.romaji: Ame ga futtemo, sentaku shimasu.
examples.english: Even if it rains, I will do laundry.

examples.japanese: たかくても、その うちが かいたいです。
examples.romaji: Takakutemo, sono uchi ga kaitai desu.
examples.english: Even if it's expensive, I want to buy that house.

grammar_point: もし／いくら (If / However much)
english_explanation: もし is used together with the Plain past ら sentence pattern, while いくら is used together with the ～ても/～でも sentence pattern, both expressing a conditional/hypothetical situation. もし means 'if', and いくら means 'no matter how much/however much'.
nepali_explanation: もし चाँही Plain past ら को वाक्यसँग प्रयोग गरिन्छ भने いくら चाँही ～ても／～でも को वाक्यसँग प्रयोग गरिन्छ र स्थीतिजन्य शर्त उत्पन्न हुने अवस्थालाई व्यक्त गर्दछ। もし को अर्थ 'यदि' हुन्छ भने いくら को अर्थ 'जतिनै' हुन्छ।

examples.japanese: もし １おくえん あったら、いろいろな くにを りょこうしたいです。
examples.romaji: Moshi ichioku-en attara, iroiro na kuni o ryokō shitai desu.
examples.english: If I had 100 million yen, I would want to travel to various countries.

examples.japanese: いくら たかくても、その うちを かいます。
examples.romaji: Ikura takakutemo, sono uchi o kaimasu.
examples.english: No matter how expensive it is, I will buy that house.

grammar_point: Subject of a Subordinate Clause marked by が
form: subordinate clause の subject が
english_explanation: When a sentence has a main clause and a subordinate clause (like a まえに clause), the subject of the subordinate clause is marked with が, not は — even though は is normally used to mark the topic of a full sentence.
nepali_explanation: अधीनस्थ खण्ड (subordinate clause, जस्तै まえに भएको वाक्यांश) को विषय (subject) लाई は को सट्टा が ले संकेत गरिन्छ, जबकि सामान्यतया पुरा वाक्यको विषय (topic) は ले नै संकेत गरिन्छ।

examples.japanese: ともだちが くる まえに、へやを そうじします。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi ga kuru mae ni, heya o sōji shimasu.
examples.english: Before my friend comes, I clean the room.
